name: CurrencyInput
tagline: Currency Input is a money field.
description: Currency Input is a money field. While you type it shows a plain number; when you leave the field it shows the formatted amount with the currency symbol and separators, for example S$1,234.50.
features: Step buttons and optional amount-in-words (cheque / payment voucher style)
Built for Power Pages basic and multistep forms
Also works on model-driven and canvas apps
